claim.statement: The platform has no OpenTelemetry or OTLP export for metrics, logs or traces; traces are left to applications' own OpenTelemetry SDKs and external collectors.

sources.quote: Applications export traces to external collectors (Jaeger, Tempo, Datadog) using standard OpenTelemetry SDKs.

claim.gap: No mention found of otlp (rg -n -i "otlp" README.md docs/whitepaper.md docs/manual docs/README.md docs/design returned nothing). The only OpenTelemetry mention is the whitepaper section 22 note that a distributed tracing backend is deliberately not included and apps should use OpenTelemetry SDKs directly.
claim.measurable: Search the config schema and binary for an OTLP endpoint option; run an OTLP collector on a separate host and verify bun sends nothing to port 4317/4318. An app that exports spans to an external collector works through normal egress (an egress allow list needs the collector host:port).
